_about: Question evaluation set. Each case runs offline in CI against a fixture graph (planner_replies stand in for the model) and live with `amass ai eval` against a real model and Asset Database. Add a case for every question a user reports; a fix counts when the new case and every earlier one pass.

cases.question: Please create a table with each website, it's IP address, and hosting provider that's within the Colgate University organization?
cases.note: Reported 2026-11-09: explore search hit the node limit and found nothing; needs the table answer kind. On 2026-11-09 Qwen needed two corrections (row type, then column chain). Repeated columns are now repaired without a call and the row-type retry is schema-constrained, so two calls is the budget; tighten to one if the live eval allows; the column chain may include intermediate columns (for example FQDN before IP address).

cases.question: Which third-party vendors are used by colgate.edu?
cases.note: Roadmap 1c: the model's summary must cite the stored relationships it uses, verified in Go. On 2026-11-10 Qwen's summaries named the subject (colgate.edu) in sentences citing www.colgate.edu items; naming the question's subject is now allowed in any cited sentence.

planner_replies: colgate.edu receives mail through mx1.pphosted.com and uses pdns1.ultradns.net as a name server [E1, E2]. colgate.edu relies on FASTLY: www.colgate.edu resolves to 151.101.1.1, which AutonomousSystem 54113 announces and whose registration names FASTLY [E6, E7, E8, E9]. Its certificate was issued by DigiCert Inc [E3, E4, E5]. The domain's registrar contact belongs to EDUCAUSE [E10, E11].
